[[File:Desert_Nekarr_Cat.png|thumb|right|200px|A nekarr cat]]
The '''nekarr cat''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Feline/Legends|feline]] creatures with four legs. They could survive in a number of varied environments, from savannahs and deserts to forests and tundras.
